boundary: The theorem identifies module content; it does not choose canonical bases inside repeated isotypic multiplicity spaces.
correction: The earlier tentative 135=15+4*30 grouping is false. Exact projector intersections give 135=60+15+2*30, while the remaining two 30-dimensional copies form the rank-nine 60-space.
theorem: Exact rational spectral projectors of an integer central orbital-algebra element intersect the nine fusion idempotents in the displayed integer matrix. This proves the full PSp(4,3)-module content of every rank-nine eigenspace and corrects the former dimension-only conjecture.
